opening.argument: FTT is presented as an investment with appreciation potential and a profit opportunity through staking. The speaker calls it underestimated, describes its growth as exponential, and says investing in FTT and staking it can generate profit. The presentation also highlights practical rewards: staking on the platform increases the referral rate, while the FTT Staking Program banner lists a higher referral bonus, maker rebate, more votes, and additional airdrop rewards. The financial-advice disclaimer and call to research investments do not remove these specific investment and reward claims.

citations.quote: if you want to invest in something more concrete that can also give you the opportunity to generate a certain profit with staking, FTT is the right choice.
If the FTT staking is carried out within the platform, we have an increase in the reference rate.
